The '''Droid Storage Module''' was a small cargo compartment for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] manufactured by [[Utilitech/Legends|Utilitech]]. The module could either be [[Magnetic seal/Legends|magnetically sealed]] to the exterior of the droid, or installed internally. The modules were small enough to carry objects such as a [[Blaster/Legends|small blaster]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], or [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="CFTD" />

The Droid Storage Module was often illegally modified to act as a [[sensor-shielded storage compartment]] using [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-absorbent materials to obscure the contents from scans.<ref name="CFTD" />
